snippet.title: Orbis Fugae Steam Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Orbis Fugae is now available to wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1237190/Orbis_Fugae/

Past meets present: Orbis Fugae combines traditional Point&Click Gameplay with puzzle design straight out of popular Escape Room mechanics. Many puzzles require the player to investigate the environment and documents, check rooms and scenes for irregularities, clues or hints, and think outside the box.
Follow self-crowned Pirate Queen Anya Ophelia Morgan on a world-spanning quest to uncover the truth about her father, a secret treasure, an unknown cult and – most of all – herself.
